title: Glazed Cherry Honey Infused Hair & Body Mist

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Mist & Hair Mist > Women > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Alcohol Free✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora
Fragrance Family: Florals

Scent Type: Fruity Florals

Key Notes: Juicy Cherry, Fresh Raspberry, Sweet Caramel

Fragrance Description: An irresistible blend of juicy cherry, fresh raspberry, and sweet caramel. Fun, flirty, and made to be noticed.

About the Fragrance: An alcohol-free fragrance mist enriched with Mirsalehi Honey Water, hyaluronic acid, and peptides to scent and hydrate hair and skin for a honey glow from head to toe.

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well and mist all over hair and body for a honey glow from head to toe.
Ingredients+
Aqua (Water, Eau), Isopentyldiol, Parfum (Fragrance), C12-13 Alketh-9, Xylitylglucoside, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sh-Polypeptide-123, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Pelvetia Canaliculata Extract, Anhydroxylitol, Maltitol, Xylitol, Benzyl Glycol, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl P-Cresol, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Raspberry Ketone, Benzyl Alcohol, Benzaldehyde**, Coumarin**, Eugenol**, Geraniol**, Pinene**, Rose Ketones**, Vanillin**.
